title: Luthen Rael
subtitle: Rebel
description: The mysterious Luthan Rael traveled to Ferrix to acquire a rather desirable piece of technology from Cassian Andor. Once together, Rael recruited Andor for a job - rob the Imperial payroll. It turned out that though Luthen was a master of antiquities, he also had a keen interest in sabotaging the Empire and watching the Emperor's kingdom crumble.
